mapper.sql: o.id,o.order_no AS orderNo,o.user_id AS userId,u.phone,u.nickname, o.listing_id AS listingId,o.channel_id AS channelId,o.channel_name AS channelName, o.product_code AS productCode,o.product_name AS productName,o.color_name AS colorName,o.hex1,o.hex2,o.size, o.unit_price AS unitPrice,o.quantity,o.total_price AS totalPrice,o.status,o.created_at AS createdAt,o.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sales_order o JOIN customer u ON u.id=o.user_id ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT FROM sales_order o JOIN customer u ON u.id=o.user_id WHERE o.id=#{id}

SELECT uc.user_id AS userId,uc.channel_id AS channelId FROM user_channel uc JOIN customer u ON u.id=uc.user_id LEFT JOIN simulation_run r ON r.id=u.simulation_run_id WHERE (u.simulation_run_id IS NULL OR u.simulation_run_id=#{runId} OR r.retain_data=TRUE) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM listing l JOIN sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id JOIN product_color pc ON pc.id=s.color_id JOIN product p ON p.id=pc.product_id WHERE l.channel_id=uc.channel_id AND l.on_sale=1 AND pc.deleted=0 AND p.deleted=0 ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT l.id AS listingId,#{userId} AS userId,c.id AS channelId,c.name AS channelName,p.code AS productCode,p.name AS productName, pc.name AS colorName,pc.hex1,pc.hex2,s.size,l.price AS unitPrice FROM listing l JOIN sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id JOIN product_color pc ON pc.id=s.color_id JOIN product p ON p.id=pc.product_id JOIN channel c ON c.id=l.channel_id WHERE l.channel_id=#{channelId} AND l.on_sale=1 AND pc.deleted=0 AND p.deleted=0 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET status=#{to},updated_at=#{changedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{from}
